trip.title: Seoul → Busan
trip.subtitle: Nine days, two cities, room to wander.
trip.date_note: Working calendar only: Nov 1–9, 2026 matches the supplied weekday pattern. The original also said ‘Nov 2, 2006’; the year is not confirmed.
trip.provenance: The complete originally supplied day-by-day text is not available in this checkout. This is a source-checked, editorially proposed sequence of the identifiable stops—not a transcription or a set of confirmed bookings.

days.title: Arrive & settle in
days.subtitle: A deliberately light first evening in Myeongdong.

depart.text: If landing at Incheon, Stanford's FAQ suggests airport bus 6015 to the Ibis Myeongdong stop, then walk to its Centerpoint Building entrance. Alternatively, the AREX Express reaches Seoul Station and the metro map shows Line 4 onward to Myeongdong. Flight, terminal, arrival time and bus service are unconfirmed.

stops.why: Find the 9th-floor lobby. Check-in starts at 15:00; ask about luggage if you arrive sooner.
Stay close to the hotel and browse only shops that are actually open.
Just opposite the hotel; check the live calendar rather than assuming a fixed Sunday closing time.

return.text: Return to Stanford on foot; do not rely on a prearranged room until the reservation is confirmed.

days.note: No flight details were supplied in the saved materials. Gwangjang retail closes Sundays; its food street is a separate option, but no cross-city dash is planned for arrival day.

days.title: Palaces & hanok lanes
days.subtitle: A walk through Jongno, before Bukchon's visitor cutoff.

depart.text: From the hotel side of Euljiro 1-ga (Line 2), ride to Euljiro 3-ga and transfer to Line 3 for Gyeongbokgung Station. Use Exit 5 for the palace; check station signs and current train times on the day.

stops.why: Palace visit moved to Monday because the regular Tuesday closure makes the original Tuesday placement unsuitable.
From the palace district, use Line 3 to Anguk or walk. Enter the restricted tourist zone only between 10:00 and 17:00; be quiet.
Browse the traditional shopping street via Anguk; shops close individually.
Continue toward Jongno 3-ga for the hanok alleys; not subject to Bukchon's red-zone visitor rule, but respect residents.
Rain Report Rainbow is officially listed here in Ikseon—not the uncertain Seongsu Croissant site.

return.text: From Jongno 3-ga, use Line 1 to City Hall and Line 2 to Euljiro 1-ga, or walk back if convenient. Compare with the live metro map.

days.note: This is a suggested correction, not a change to a verified booking. Leave Gyeongbokgung before its 17:00 November close; the last entry is 16:00.

days.title: Markets, design & a skyline
days.subtitle: A flexible eastward downtown loop with Namsan after dark.

depart.text: From Euljiro 1-ga (Line 2), ride to Euljiro 4-ga and walk to Gwangjang Market at 88 Changgyeonggung-ro. The exact best exit is not established in these sources; use the address and local wayfinding.

stops.why: Browse retail before its 18:00 close and try the independently listed food street; stall-specific details vary.
From Euljiro 4-ga, continue on Line 2 to Dongdaemun History & Culture Park, Exit 1. This is Dongdaemun, not Seongsu.
Take Line 4 from the DDP station to Myeongdong; use Exit 3 on foot or Exit 4 for the Namsan Ormi approach.
The observatory is a separate ticket; weekday entry ends 30 minutes before the 22:30 close.

return.text: Return by cable car if operating or use the tower's published Namsan 01A/01B bus route. Do not assume a specific last departure time from these sources.

days.note: This is the busiest Seoul day. Skip either DDP interiors or the paid tower if queues or energy make the loop too long. No exhibition or cable-car tickets are booked.

days.title: Seongsu, slowly
days.subtitle: Design shops and salt bread along Yeonmujang-gil.

depart.text: From Euljiro 1-ga take Line 2 toward Seongsu Station. Walk between each operator-listed address; the street's pop-ups have changing schedules.

stops.why: The official directory distinguishes Seongsu Space from its other nearby shop formats.
A takeaway bread stop; the tourism listing notes queues and batch baking.
Browse the operator's Seongsu fashion flagship.
Use the current 13 Yeonmujang 11-gil flagship address, not an older stockist listing.

return.text: Return to Euljiro 1-ga on Line 2. Eat wherever is convenient; individual Seongsu restaurants without official confirmation are not scheduled.

days.note: All stops are browse-as-you-go rather than appointments. Rain Report Croissant in Seongsu is not routed here; its status needs confirmation.

days.title: Gangnam & one last city meal
days.subtitle: COEX first, then a return to Myeongdong.

depart.text: Use Line 2 from Euljiro 1-ga to Samseong; follow the COEX operator's direct connections at Exits 5/6. Check metro direction and service on the day.

stops.why: Mall opening hours are not the opening hours of each shop or exhibition.
Back in Myeongdong for kalguksu; the Michelin distinction is Bib Gourmand, not a star.
A better time to browse Lotte Main than its published Nov 9 closure.

return.text: From Samseong, return on Line 2 toward Euljiro 1-ga, then walk to the hotel. Use official station wayfinding for the correct platform.

days.note: Mangwon Market is an optional separate half-day, not adjacent to COEX; avoid squeezing it into this day just to tick a box.

days.title: Ride south to Haeundae
days.subtitle: A train day with a low-pressure beachside finish.

depart.text: From Stanford's Euljiro 1-ga area, take Line 2 to City Hall, transfer to Line 1 for Seoul Station, then a Seoul–Busan Gyeongbu KTX only after booking a real departure. At Busan Station take Metro Line 1 to Seomyeon, transfer to Line 2 for Haeundae and use L7's published address for the final walk. No ticket or exact departure is confirmed.

stops.why: The listed check-in is 15:00. Ask the property directly about early arrival and bags; no storage policy was verified.
Easy nearby shoreline stroll. November is outside a guaranteed swimming program.
A flexible market meal within the Haeundae area; vendor-specific hours and prices vary.

return.text: Walk back to L7 using its street address; no late-night transit is required by this proposed sequence.

days.note: KORAIL says tickets open at 07:00 two months ahead; VisitKorea says they usually open one month ahead. Rely on the rail operator and confirm availability before building the day around a train.

days.title: Coastal lines & temple steps
days.subtitle: An east-Busan day with an optional Saturday waterfront finale.

depart.text: Start from L7's Haeundae address and make your way to the Mipo end of Blueline Park. Use operator maps to find the correct scenic-rail boarding point; Sky Capsule tickets have not been purchased.

stops.why: Mipo to Cheongsapo is a one-way scenic ride; confirm availability and live price before committing.
A separate train can bring you back along the coast; ticket and fare are not confirmed.
From Haeundae Line 2 Exit 7, use the official Busan tourism bus guidance; the temple's last admission is 18:50.
Line 2 links Haeundae and Gwangan; walk to the beach for bridge views.
The usual winter Saturday show pattern is 19:00/21:00, but the Nov 7 program and weather clearance are unconfirmed.

return.text: If ending at Gwangalli, ride Line 2 from Gwangan back to Haeundae for L7. Otherwise head straight back from the temple area.

days.note: Keep the capsule and the evening show optional: both depend on live availability, and the operator's conflicting fare pages make a fixed capsule price unreliable.

days.title: Old Busan, then back north
days.subtitle: An optional hillside and market before a proposed Seoul overnight.

depart.text: Check out of L7 by 11:00. From Haeundae ride Line 2 to Seomyeon, change to Line 1 toward Toseong for Gamcheon (village bus from Exit 6); for a shorter route, skip Gamcheon and continue to Jagalchi. Luggage storage at L7 has not been verified.

stops.why: Aim before the visitor-facility 17:00 close; steep lanes are awkward with large luggage. Skip if your return train is early.
Near Busan Station on Line 1, making it the easier choice if time or baggage is tight.
Walk the nearby cinema street; vendor hours are not verified.

return.text: From Jagalchi or Toseong, take Metro Line 1 to Busan Station. Book a suitable KTX to Seoul Station; to reach Stanford, use Seoul Metro Line 1 to City Hall and Line 2 to Euljiro 1-ga. A Nov 8 Seoul room is not confirmed and must not be assumed available.

days.note: The suggested Sunday return avoids relying on an unverified Busan-to-airport same-day transfer. It is a proposal only: train departure, baggage arrangements and Seoul overnight all remain unresolved.

days.title: Leave with a buffer
days.subtitle: Keep the departure day open until the flight is known.

depart.text: If departing from Incheon after a confirmed Seoul overnight, check out of Stanford by 12:00. From Euljiro 1-ga use Line 2 to City Hall and Line 1 to Seoul Station; take a separately ticketed AREX Express to the correct ICN terminal. Operator running time from Seoul Station: 43 min to T1 or 51 min to T2, excluding transfers, security and airport check-in.

stops.why: Use the hotel's check-out rule only if a Nov 8 return-night room has actually been reserved.
Operator calendar currently does not mark Nov 9 closed; recheck on the day. Do not go to Lotte Main, which lists Nov 9 as a closure.

return.text: No flight, airline, departure terminal or airport is verified. The AREX route is conditional on an Incheon departure, not a ticket or guaranteed connection.

days.note: If departure is early, drop all shopping. Stanford's after-checkout bag storage ends at midnight the same day; it is not a substitute for an extra hotel night.
